temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project; Cheryl gratefully accepts Maria's offer of help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria did not previously believe Cheryl was overwhelmed; she may have assumed Cheryl was managing the project as usual.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Maria learns Cheryl is struggling with the project workload and is open to assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is currently stressed and overwhelmed but willing to accept help; Maria's assistance is welcome.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, compassion, and a desire to be supportive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Cheryl with the paperwork and planning so she feels less overwhelmed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing more confident; in the staff meeting, Cheryl accepts Maria's suggestion to lead the next phase and thanks her for the confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed Cheryl had been stressed and needed help; she may not yet have believed Cheryl was ready for a formal leadership role.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Maria's view of Cheryl shifts from someone who needed support to someone capable and ready to lead; Cheryl's acceptance confirms this.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is capable, confident, and willing to take on leadership; Maria's confidence in her is validated.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Pride, satisfaction, and confidence in Cheryl.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl in the leadership role and see the project succeed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria approaches Cheryl privately to check that her leadership suggestion did not feel like pressure; Cheryl says she was surprised but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed Cheryl had accepted the leadership role well, but she worried her suggestion might have overstepped or made Cheryl feel pressured.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Maria's worry is reduced; Cheryl clarifies she felt supported, not pressured.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl values Maria's support and has no hard feelings; Maria's suggestion did not damage their relationship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain open communication and ensure Cheryl continues to feel supported.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After the private conversation, Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support; Maria proposes co-leading the project, and Cheryl enthusiastically agrees, saying Maria's guidance is invaluable and they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed Cheryl appreciated her support and that their collaboration could continue, but she had not yet established a formal co-leading arrangement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Cheryl's enthusiastic agreement confirms she wants to co-lead and values Maria's guidance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl can work effectively as co-leaders and support each other; Cheryl sees them as a great team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue their supportive collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria sees that she and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership; when Maria asks about teaming up for more future projects, Cheryl says she would love it and is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed their co-leading and collaboration had been promising and supportive, but she did not yet know how strongly Cheryl would want to continue into future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Reinforced - the successful projects confirm their synergy, and Cheryl's enthusiastic response confirms she wants more collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is strong, fruitful, and likely to continue successfully; Cheryl is excited about future work together.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue teaming up with Cheryl on future projects.
